operations.title: Operational evidence
operations.lead: Read-only evidence from FastAPI, TrueNAS, pfSense and Cloudflare. Use it to identify which layer is failing before changing configuration.

board.pending: Initial evidence collection is still running.

pfsense.title: pfSense ingress and security evidence
pfsense.blockedDetail: The exact observed FastAPI Cloud egress is present in the pfSense snort2c table. This is direct block evidence, not an inference.
pfsense.blindSpotDetail: The pfSense security observer shares the same WAN path it is trying to diagnose, so a transport failure cannot prove whether Snort/PF blocked its own telemetry.

actions.title: pfSense needs attention
actions.lead: pfSense is degraded, stale, or selected as the current troubleshooting focus. Inspect the evidence first, then open the management surfaces if you need to verify the control plane directly.
actions.apiTitle: Open the read-only pfSense system version endpoint; authorized API access may be required.
actions.note: Admin/API links are diagnostic entry points, not proof that pfSense caused the incident.

exposure.title: Trusted-source exposure policy
exposure.lead: Positive reachability from FastAPI Cloud is expected for approved monitoring paths. It does not prove that unrelated Internet origins are denied.

freshness.title: Evidence freshness and dependency structure
freshness.none: No stale service observations or required dependency cycles are currently reported.

credentials.title: Observer configuration
credentials.lead: Only sanitized configuration state and environment-variable names are exposed; secret values are never returned.

troubleshoot.title: Start troubleshooting here
troubleshoot.pfsense_block: pfSense / Snort first: an exact snort2c block attribution is available. Inspect the Snort alert/rule and PF table before changing TrueNAS, HAProxy or the application.
troubleshoot.pfsense_blind_spot: pfSense telemetry path first: the security observer shares the WAN path and currently has a blind spot. Restore or move telemetry out-of-band before attributing the failure to Snort.
troubleshoot.pfsense_control: pfSense control plane first: the REST API evidence is failing. Use failure stage, transport error and last-good snapshot before investigating downstream services.
troubleshoot.cloudflare: Cloudflare first: the control-plane/tunnel evidence is unhealthy. Verify Tunnel inventory, Access policy and edge evidence before investigating the origin application.
troubleshoot.truenas: TrueNAS first: platform evidence is failing. Check public HAProxy/TLS, the TrueNAS API and app runtime before leaf services.
troubleshoot.stale_evidence: Freshness first: one or more conclusions rely on stale evidence. Refresh observations before treating an unknown dependency as a real outage.
troubleshoot.dependency_cycle: Dependency model first: a required dependency cycle is reported. Resolve or justify that cycle because it makes root-cause propagation ambiguous.
troubleshoot.dependencies: Service dependency path next: control planes do not currently expose a stronger root cause. Inspect the affected service local state, blocked_by list and critical dependency hierarchy.
